paper.title: Volumetric Spanners: an Efficient Exploration Basis for Learning

settings.name_in_paper: Bandit Linear Optimization (BLO) over general convex sets
settings.definition_quote: iteratively at each time sequence $t$, the environment chooses a loss vector $L_t$ that is not revealed to the player. The player chooses a vector $x_t \in \K$ where $\K \subseteq \reals^d$ is convex, and once she commits to her choice, the loss $\ell_t = x_t^\top L_t$ is revealed. ... the loss functions are always chosen (by an oblivious adversary) from a convex set $\cal Z$ such that $\K$ is contained in its polar

symbols.s: max_t |S_t|, size of the exploration spanner set
symbols.logN_K: log |K|_{1/T}, log of the size of a 1/T-net of K w.r.t. the norm defined by the loss set

conditions: K equipped with a membership oracle
losses satisfy |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K

source.label: thm:geo hedge
source.quote: Under the assumptions stated above, and let $s=\max_t |S_t|$, $ \eta = \sqrt{\frac{\log |\K|_{1/T}}{dT}}$ and let $\gamma = s\sqrt{\frac{\log(|\K|_{1/T})}{dT}} $. Algorithm \ref{alg:BLO} given parameters $\gamma,\eta$ suffers a regret bounded by $$ O\left(  (s+d)\sqrt{\frac{T \log |\K|_{1/T} }{d}} \right)$$

results.notes: Regret is E[sum L_t^T x_t] - sum L_t^T x* against an oblivious adversary. Compute: polynomial per round via approximate log-concave sampling (Corollary 7.2: O~(d^5 + d^3 T^6) per iteration).

conditions: K equipped with a membership oracle
losses satisfy |L^T x| <= 1 for all x in K

source.quote: There exist an efficient algorithm for BLO for any convex set $\K$ with regret of $$ O\left(  \sqrt{dT \log |\K|_{1/T}  } \right) = O\left(  d\sqrt{T \log(T)  } \right) $$

results.notes: Obtained from Theorem 7.1 with s = d (barycentric-spanner-based ratio spanner) and log|K|_{1/T} <= d log T. Running time O~(d^5 + d^3 T^6) per iteration (Corollary 7.2).
